evidence: Protected objects use a versioned streaming XChaCha20-Poly1305 secretstream envelope. Every object receives a random 256-bit data key, and the data key is wrapped with XChaCha20-Poly1305 under a versioned project key. Only authenticated ciphertext and key-version metadata are persisted; plaintext is streamed directly from the caller and never staged in a temporary file or written to logs.

Open authenticates the complete envelope and checks plaintext length and SHA-256 before returning the controlled reader. Ciphertext, header, wrapped-key, and metadata tampering fail closed and quarantine the object without exposing a plaintext byte.

A missing or unusable project key raises the bounded ObjectKeyUnavailable error and does not silently classify recoverable key loss as object corruption. Rotation selects the current key for new objects while prior key versions remain readable.

Seven direct encrypted-object tests cover successful round trip with no plaintext residue, ciphertext/header/wrapped-key tampering, missing keys, rotation with old-key readability, process restart, interrupted writes, and the explicitly gated plaintext fixture mode.

The 69-test data suite covers version-3 migration from empty, v1, and v2 databases; rollback and retry at every material v2/v3 failpoint; schema history; restart; corruption; alias/race denial; and the existing local-object boundaries. The exact-final 121-test affected union and both full task profiles pass.

Strict portable object-store and SQLite profiles now bind encrypted-envelope version, cipher suite, key identifier/version, nonce/header handling, wrapped-key metadata, plaintext-fixture gating, schema version 3, and migration recovery history. The v0003 migration is transactional, failpoint-tested, and idempotently retryable.

The dependency-neutral object-store key port, architecture guide, implementation plan, packaging inventory, quality scope, frozen-sidecar hook, PyNaCl lockfile, and supply-chain policy are updated together. MIT-0 is documented and tested for the cffi transitive dependency while an adjacent unlisted license remains denied.

There is no UI/reference change and no quota, garbage-collection, cache-policy, or later-slice expansion. Unencrypted storage is available only through the explicit allow_plaintext_fixture test construction; production construction without a key provider fails closed.
